reason: The update changes five property-relevant guarantees: (1) auto-leave is now edge-triggered, uses a zero-size nil-Data entry that can never be refused, and bumps pendingConfIndex (raft.go:556-584); (2) the leader now refuses non-leave conf changes while joint and empty conf changes while not joint (raft.go:1036-1073); (3) zero-size appends are never quota-refused (raft.go:1616); (4) a leader aborts a transfer whose target is no longer a voter in either joint half, which now covers demotion (raft.go:1568-1571); (5) new Progress starts at Next=LastIndex and newly added replicas are probed when the config switches (confchange.go:265, raft.go:1556-1567). The old AutoLeaveAdvance, ProposalConfigurationDecisions and OutcomeSoundness no longer describe what the source promises, so they are revised. ConfigurationTransitionSafety is strengthened because it wrongly treated auto-leave entries (id=0) as bootstrap axioms. Four properties are added for behaviors nothing currently observes: JointStateConsistency, LeaderTransfereeVoter/TransferConfigAbort, NewReplicaProbe and ProgressNextBounds. All other properties are kept, and their justification must be rechecked. One promise is deliberately NOT weakened: a leader must auto-leave once its pending configuration is applied. AutoLeaveAdvance_new keeps that obligation even though the new edge trigger is expected to violate it after a leader election (suspected defect D1).

scope.source_delta: update.patch: raft.go, confchange/confchange.go, raftpb/confchange.go, log_unstable.go, util.go, tests/testdata
scope.not_done_in_this_call: No TLC or test runs. No spec, cfg or code edits. Expressions below are proposals for the modeling/validation phases.

shared_definitions.purpose: Independent oracles that the revised and new properties use. They are written from source and contract evidence, not copied from the draft's RewriteConf or AdvanceCore. Observer fields are ghost-only and must never guard protocol actions.
tla: WantsLeave(e) == e.kind="V2" /\ e.changes= <<>>   \* raft.go:1055 len(cc.AsV2().Changes)==0; V1 AsV2 always has one change (raftpb/confchange.go:50-58)
JointCompatible(cfg,e) == IF cfg.outgoing#{} THEN WantsLeave(e) ELSE ~WantsLeave(e)   \* raft.go:1060-1064
AdmittableConf(o) == {k\in DOMAIN o.entries: o.entries[k].kind\in ConfKinds /\ JointCompatible(o.config,o.entries[k])}

AcceptedConf(o) == IF o.pending>o.applied \/ AdmittableConf(o)={} THEN {} ELSE {MinSet(AdmittableConf(o))}   \* first admissible conf entry sets pendingConfIndex (raft.go:1070); every later conf entry in the batch sees alreadyPending
EffectiveEntries(o) == [k\in DOMAIN o.entries |-> IF o.entries[k].kind\in ConfKinds /\ k\notin AcceptedConf(o) THEN Entry(0,0,"Normal",0,0,0,EmptyEncoded) ELSE o.entries[k]]   \* raft.go:1068
NewMsgs(before,after) == {m\in DOMAIN after: after[m]>(IF m\in DOMAIN before THEN before[m] ELSE 0)}

entries.name: ProposalConfigurationDecisions -> ProposalConfigurationDecisions_new
entries.summary: The admission oracle gains the joint/non-joint refusal rules, and the quota refusal now requires a nonzero payload. Only conf entries that were actually accepted block later entries. A newly accepted conf entry must set pendingConf to its own index.
evidence: new/source/raft.go:1052-1073 (alreadyPending / alreadyJoint / wantsLeaveJoint; refused entries rewritten to EntryNormal; pendingConfIndex only set when accepted)
new/source/raft_test.go:186-189,251-265 (TestUncommittedEntryLimit: Data-less entry always appended over the limit)
new/source/testdata/confchange_v2_add_double_auto.txt:238-279 (conf proposals while joint do not re-enter)
old/spec/base.tla:742-765 (old ProposalContract lacks joint rules and the w>0 term)
entries.expression:
ProposalContract_new(o) ==
  LET eff == EffectiveEntries(o)
      expected == IF o.role="Leader" THEN
          IF o.node\notin VoterIDs(o.config)\cup o.config.learners THEN "DropRemoved"
          ELSE IF o.transfer#0 THEN "DropTransfer"
          ELSE IF QuotaRefuses(o.quota,Weight(eff)) THEN "DropQuota" ELSE "Accepted"
        ELSE IF o.role#"Follower" \/ o.lead=0 THEN "DropNoLeader"
        ELSE IF o.noForward THEN "DropForwardDisabled" ELSE "Forwarded"
  IN /\ o.decision=expected
     /\ IF expected="Accepted" THEN
          /\ Len(o.after)=Len(o.before)+Len(eff) /\ Prefix(o.after,Len(o.before))=o.before
          /\ \A k\in DOMAIN eff: LET e==o.after[Len(o.before)+k] w==eff[k] IN
               /\ e.kind=w.kind /\ e.id=w.id /\ e.target=w.target /\ e.changes=w.changes
               /\ e.transition=w.transition /\ e.weight=w.weight
               /\ (e.id#0 => e.id\in RequestId /\ o.requests[e.id].kind=e.kind /\
                    IF e.kind="V2" THEN o.requests[e.id].changes=e.changes ELSE o.requests[e.id].target=e.target)
          /\ o.pendingAfter=IF AcceptedConf(o)={} THEN o.pending ELSE Len(o.before)+MinSet(AcceptedConf(o))
        ELSE o.after=o.before
ProposalConfigurationDecisions_new == \A o\in quality.proposals: ProposalContract_new(o)
entries.representation_note: ProposalObservation must also record config |-> r.config (the joint status is not recoverable from voters/learners) and pendingAfter |-> a.pendingConf.
entries.cfg: Disable ProposalConfigurationDecisions in MC.cfg, base.cfg, every MC_hunt_*.cfg, Trace.cfg and TraceCorrespondence.cfg; enable ProposalConfigurationDecisions_new in their place and in the V03 Update cfgs.

entries.name: OutcomeSoundness -> OutcomeSoundness_new
entries.summary: The quota refusal requires weight>0. The effective weight is computed by the independent admission oracle, not by the draft's RewriteConf, which the old outcome record called directly in base.tla:909-910.
entries.expression:
ExpectedDecision_new(o) ==
  IF o.role="Leader" THEN
     IF ~o.member THEN "DropRemoved" ELSE IF o.transfer#0 THEN "DropTransfer"
     ELSE IF QuotaRefuses(o.quota,Weight(EffectiveEntries(o))) THEN "DropQuota" ELSE "Accepted"
  ELSE IF o.role#"Follower" \/ o.lead=0 THEN "DropNoLeader"
  ELSE IF ~o.forwarding THEN "DropForwardDisabled" ELSE "Forwarded"
OutcomeSoundness_new == \A o\in history.outcomes: o.decision=ExpectedDecision_new(o)
entries.representation_note: In the outcome record, replace weight |-> Weight(RewriteConf(...)) with entries |-> m.entries, config |-> raft[n].config, pending |-> raft[n].pendingConf, applied |-> raft[n].applied.
entries.cfg: Replace OutcomeSoundness with OutcomeSoundness_new in MC_hunt_3_node.cfg, MC_hunt_3_configuration_application.cfg, MC_hunt_6_outcomes.cfg, Trace.cfg and TraceCorrespondence.cfg.

entries.name: AutoLeaveAdvance -> AutoLeaveAdvance_new (and rebind UpdateAutoLeaveAdvance)
entries.summary: Three changes: (a) the DropQuota/retry escape is removed, because the leave entry is un-refusable and a refusal now panics; (b) the leave entry must have zero payload, and pendingConf must equal its index; (c) a converse is added: no leave may be appended while a conf entry is still unapplied by the application (this dedupe is the source's own regression fix). The old obligation to append once applied>=pendingConf in an autoLeave joint config is KEPT and is NOT narrowed to the new edge trigger oldApplied<pendingConf.
evidence: new/source/raft.go:556-584 (reduce quota first; trigger; nil Data; panic on refusal; pendingConfIndex = lastIndex)
new/source/testdata/confchange_v2_add_double_auto.txt:238-240 (regression: leaving the same joint state multiple times caused a panic)
new/source/rawnode_test.go:319-331 (pendingConfIndex = index of the auto-leave entry)
entries.expression:
AutoLeaveDue(a) ==
  /\ a.cursor>0 /\ a.role="Leader" /\ a.config.autoLeave /\ a.config.outgoing#{}
  /\ a.applied>=a.pendingBefore /\ a.applied>=a.cfgLen
  /\ \A k\in (a.cfgLen+1)..Len(a.beforeHist): a.beforeHist[k].kind\notin ConfKinds
AutoLeaveAdvance_new == \A a\in history.autoLeaveChecks:
  IF AutoLeaveDue(a) THEN
     /\ a.fatal="" /\ a.decision#"DropQuota"
     /\ Len(a.afterHist)=Len(a.beforeHist)+1 /\ Prefix(a.afterHist,Len(a.beforeHist))=a.beforeHist
     /\ LET e==a.afterHist[Len(a.afterHist)] IN
          e.kind="V2" /\ e.id=0 /\ e.changes= <<>> /\ e.transition="Auto" /\ e.weight=0
     /\ a.pending=Len(a.afterHist)
  ELSE a.afterHist=a.beforeHist
entries.representation_note: autoLeaveChecks records cursor |-> b.cursor, role |-> r.role, config |-> r.config, cfgLen |-> Len(r.cfgHist), pendingBefore |-> r.pendingConf, applied |-> a.applied, beforeHist |-> Hist(r), afterHist |-> Hist(a), pending |-> a.pendingConf, decision |-> a.decision, fatal |-> a.fatal.

entries.cfg: Rebind UpdateAutoLeaveAdvance == AutoLeaveAdvance_new in Update.tla. Remove the stale enablement of the old binding from Update_full.cfg and Update_focused.cfg.

entries.name: ConfigurationTransitionSafety -> ConfigurationTransitionSafety_new
entries.summary: The old version excluded every id=0 conf entry as a 'bootstrap axiom', which also excluded auto-leave entries. Those entries are quorum decisions appended by the leader under its joint config. The new version excludes bootstrap entries only. This makes the commit-side consumer observe the changed auto-leave path.

ConfigurationTransitionSafety_new == \A c\in history.commitUses:

entries.name: JointStateConsistency
entries.category: new safety / interaction (observes admission and auto-leave through the apply consumer)
entries.summary: Every committed conf entry has a joint status that can be applied: a leave entry only follows a joint config, and every other conf entry only follows a non-joint config. This is the promise behind the new admission refusals and the 'un-refusable' auto-leave. Breaking it means applyConfChange panics.

implementation.title: A new leader never auto-leaves when its applied index equals lastIndex at election
implementation.mechanism: becomeLeader sets pendingConfIndex = lastIndex (raft.go:752). If applied == lastIndex at that moment, every later advance has oldApplied >= pendingConfIndex, so the edge trigger 'oldApplied < pendingConfIndex' (raft.go:567) never fires. The old level trigger 'index >= pendingConfIndex' did fire. The only remaining exit is an explicit leave proposed by the application. A variant: when Advance precedes ApplyConfChange of the joint-entering entry (allowed for Node by node.go:162-167), the trigger window passes while the config is not yet joint.
implementation.promise: raftpb/raft.proto:85-91,111-113 (Raft automatically transitions out of JointImplicit/auto joint configs)
implementation.do_not: Do not narrow AutoLeaveDue to oldApplied<pendingConf.

implementation.title: Duplicate auto-leave when Advance precedes ApplyConfChange of the leave entry
implementation.mechanism: After the auto-leave entry k is appended, pendingConfIndex = k (raft.go:581). If the application calls Advance with cursor >= k before ApplyConfChange(k), Config.AutoLeave is still true, so a second leave is appended. Applying it hits Changer.LeaveJoint on a non-joint config and applyConfChange panics (raft.go:1511-1514). The same happens for an application-proposed explicit leave.

implementation.title: Admission and apply disagree on what counts as 'leave'
implementation.mechanism: Admission treats any V2 with len(Changes)==0 as wantsLeaveJoint (raft.go:1055). LeaveJoint() additionally requires Transition == 0 (raftpb/confchange.go:103-107). So ConfChangeV2{Transition: JointImplicit|JointExplicit} with no changes is admitted while joint, then dispatched to EnterJoint, which returns 'config is already joint', and applyConfChange panics. When not joint, the same proposal is now refused, although the Changer accepts an empty enter-joint (confchange/testdata/joint_safety.txt:25-28): this is a semantic narrowing.

implementation.reachability: The model's V2Batches include <<>> with every transition (base.tla:1482,1488).

implementation.title: The joint-admission guard reads a stale config under early Advance
implementation.mechanism: alreadyJoint reads r.prs.Config (raft.go:1054), which changes only on ApplyConfChange, while alreadyPending compares against raftLog.applied, which changes on Advance. If Advance comes first, a non-leave conf change can be admitted while a joint-entering entry is raft-applied but not yet app-applied. Applying it later panics ('can't apply simple config change in joint config'). This is a pre-existing class of bug (the old version had no joint guard), but the new guard's promise is incomplete.

implementation.mechanism: The early return at raft.go:1537-1548 skips the abort at 1568-1571; the branch is marked 'TODO ... untested'. No promise is established, so this is recorded as unresolved, not as a violation.
